newsitem.title: USA: Bone Care successful in Phase 2 trial.
newsitem.headline: Bone Care successful in Phase 2 trial.

text.p: Bone Care International Inc said Thursday successful results from a Phase 2 clinical trial of its one-alpha D2 were published in the January issue of Kidney International.
One-alpha D2, the lead product in Bone Care's vitamin D pipeline, is under development as a treatment for secondary hyperparathyroidism associated with end-stage renal disease.
The company said a Phase 3 trial with oral one-alpha D2 in more than 200 hemodialysis patients is on schedule for completion in September.
